title: Gmail Inbox Briefing
prompt: Prepare a prioritized brief for the messages returned by this Gmail search. Identify explicit deadlines and follow-ups, then separate them from informational updates.
instructions: Use only the requested query and its returned page. list_messages provides summaries, not full bodies: call get_message for every returned ID before summarizing. State the query and result limit so this is not mistaken for an account-wide review. Do not paginate, send or draft email, change labels, or infer intent beyond the body. Distinguish explicit requests and dates from prioritization.
fixture_summary: Two synthetic messages: a supplier approval request with a Friday deadline and an informational release note. Full-message reads provide bodies for both returned IDs.
